  6class GenAIBaseBackend(VirtualObjectBackend):
  7    """Generic backend to store user-implemented AI model handlers
  8
  9    This handles storage and retrieval for GenAIModelHandler subclasses
 10    and instances, and provides bindings for the runtime to call using
 11    e.g. backend.perform('complete', 'mymodel', 'X'). Works the same
 12    as VirtualObjectBackend, but with a different KIND and supports
 13    other methods.
 14
 15    .. versionadded:: 0.17.0
 16    """
 17
 18    KIND = 'genai.llm'

 20    @classmethod
 21    def supports(self, obj, name, **kwargs):
 22        is_aimodel = isinstance(obj, GenAIModel) or hasattr(obj, '_omega_virtual_genai')
 23        is_tool = isinstance(obj, FunctionType) and any(name.startswith(v) for v in self.TOOLS_PATHS)

 26    def _ensure_handler_instance(self, obj):
 27        # always return a handler instance
 28        obj = super()._ensure_handler_instance(obj)
 29        if hasattr(obj, '_omega_virtual_genai') and isinstance(obj, FunctionType):
 30            obj = GenAIModelHandler(fn=obj)

 33    def _resolve_input_data(self, method, Xname, **kwargs):
 34        # TODO this should not be necessary, the data should be resolved by super()
 35        #      we need this only due to VirtualObjectBackend not being a ModelBackend
 36        data = self.data_store.get(Xname)
 37        meta = self.data_store.metadata(Xname)
 38        if self.tracking:
 39            self.tracking.log_event(method, 'X', {'Xname': Xname, 'data': data, 'kind': meta.kind})
 40        return data
 41
 42    def _prepare_result(self, method, result, rName=None, pure_python=False, **kwargs):
 43        # TODO this should not be necessary, the data should be resolved by super()
 44        #      we need this only due to VirtualObjectBackend not being a ModelBackend
 45        if pure_python:
 46            result = result.tolist()
 47        if rName:
 48            meta = self.data_store.put(result, rName)
 49            result = meta
 50        if self.tracking and getattr(self.tracking, 'autotrack', False):
 51            self.tracking.log_data(
 52                'Y', result, dataset=rName, kind=str(type(result)) if rName is None else meta.kind, event=method
 53            )
 54        return result

 56    def complete(self, modelname, Xname, rName=None, pure_python=True, stream=False, **kwargs):
 57        # Xname is the input given by the user
 58        model: GenAIModel
 59        model = self.get(modelname)
 60        model.load()
 61        data = self._resolve_input_data('complete', Xname, **kwargs)
 62        data = data[0] if isinstance(data, list) else data
 63        if isinstance(data, dict):
 64            # a qualified prompt, possibly as a chat
 65            prompt = data.get('prompt', '')
 66            messages = data.get('messages')
 67            user_data = data.get('data')
 68            chat = data.get('chat', False)
 69            conversation_id = data.get('conversation_id')
 70        elif isinstance(data, str):
 71            # just a single prompt, assume no chat
 72            prompt = data or ''
 73            chat = False
 74            messages = None
 75            conversation_id = None
 76            user_data = None
 77        else:
 78            raise ValueError(f'Invalid input data, expected dict or str, got {type(data)}')
 79        return model.complete(
 80            prompt,
 81            messages=messages,
 82            conversation_id=conversation_id,
 83            data=user_data,
 84            chat=chat,
 85            stream=stream,
 86            **kwargs,
 87        )
 88
 89    def generate(self, modelname, Xname, rName=None, pure_python=True, **kwargs):
 90        model = self.get(modelname)
 91        model.load()
 92        data = self._resolve_input_data('generate', Xname, **kwargs)
 93        return model.generate(data)
 94
 95    def embed(self, modelname, Xname, rName=None, pure_python=True, **kwargs):
 96        model = self.get(modelname)
 97        model.load()
 98        data = self._resolve_input_data('embed', Xname, **kwargs)
 99        if isinstance(data, str):
100            # a single document
101            documents = [data]
102            dimensions = None  # default to None, let the model decide
103        elif isinstance(data, list):
104            # a list of documents
105            data = data[0] if isinstance(data, list) and len(data) == 1 else data
106            documents = data.get('documents', data) if isinstance(data, dict) else data
107            dimensions = data.get('dimensions', None) if isinstance(data, dict) else None
108        elif isinstance(data, dict):
109            # a dict with documents, e.g. {'documents': ['doc1', 'doc2']}
110            # -- 'input' is the openai format
111            # -- 'documents' is the omegaml format
112            documents = data.get('documents', []) or data.get('input', [])
113            dimensions = data.get('dimensions', None)
114        return model.embed(documents, dimensions=dimensions)
115
116    def predict(self, *args, **kwargs):

138class GenAIModelHandler(GenAIModel, VirtualObjectHandler):
139    """
140    A base class to implement user-provided AI model handlers
141
142    Usage:
143        class MyModelHandler(GenAIModelHandler):
144            def load(self):
145                # code to load the model or pipeline
146                self.model = ...
147
148            def complete(self, ):
149                # code to run model's completion
150                return X
151
152            ...
153
154        # publish model
155        om.models.put(MyModelHandler, 'mygenai')
156
157        # get model
158        model = om.models.get('mygenai')
159        model.complete()
160
161        # use via runtime
162        om.runtime.model('mygenai').complete(prompt='hello, how are you'?)
163
164    Notes:
165        * as with other VirtualObjectHandlers, the implementation of each
166          method must be self-contained and not rely on global objects or
167          imports
168        * if you need global imports, use .load() to import them
169          and store them as instance attributes (e.g. import torch, self.torch = torch)
170        * all methods called are guaranteed to call .load() before calling the
171          actual method, subsequent calls will re-instantiate the handler and thus
172          call .load() again (i.e. do not assume caching across calls)
173
174    .. versionadded:: 0.17.0
175    """
176
177    _omega_virtual = False
178    _omega_virtual_genai = True
179
180    handler_methods = [
181        'template',
182        'prepare',
183        'chat',
184        'complete',
185        'generate',
186        'embed',
187        'toolcall',
188        'toolresult',
189        'process',
190        'retrieve',
191    ]
192
193    def __init__(self, *args, fn=None, **kwargs):
194        if callable(fn):
195            # map this instance's GenAIModel methods to the fn
196            fn_caller = lambda m: lambda *a, **kw: fn(*a, method=m, **kw)
197            for method in self.handler_methods:
198                setattr(self, method, fn_caller(method))
199
200        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
201
202    def _genai_method(self, *args, **kwargs):
203        raise NotImplementedError
204
205    def _vobj_call_map(self):
206        return {m: getattr(self, m, self._genai_method) for m in self.handler_methods} | super()._vobj_call_map()

209def virtual_genai(fn):
210    """
211    function decorator to create a virtual genai model handler from any
212    callable
213
214    Args:
215        fn: the virtual handler function
216
217    Usage:
218
219        .. code::
220
221            @virtual_genai
222            def myvirtualobj(data=None, method=None, **kwargs):
223                ...
224
225    The syntax of the actual function is:
226
227        Args:
228            *args: positional arguments
229            method (str): the name of the pipeline step
230            template (str): the template to use
231            prompt_message (str): the prompt message
232            messages (list): the list of messages, this is in the format of the model provider,
233              e.g. [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'hello world'}, ...]
234            response_message (dict): the response message, this is the format of the model provider,
235              e.g. {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'hello world'}
236            conversation_id (str): the conversation id
237            **kwargs: keyword arguments
238
239        Returns:
240            * None: to continue the pipeline without changes
241            * for method=template: the template string to use
242            * for method=prepare: the list of messages to use, each message must of
243                format {'role': 'user', 'content': 'hello world'}
244            * for method=process: the response message to use as a dict of format
245                {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'hello world'}
246            * for method=toolcall: the list of messages to use, each message must of
247                format {'role': 'tool', 'content': 'hello world'}
248            * for method=toolresult: the response message to use as a dict of format
249                {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'hello world'}
250
251    Returns:
252        fn
253
254    .. versionadded:: 0.17.0
255    """
256    fn._omega_virtual_genai = True
257    return fn
